summary.text: John Stevens is a Republican state senator from Huntingdon representing Tennessee Senate District 24 (Benton, Carroll, Gibson, Henry, Houston, Obion, Stewart and Weakley Counties), a member of the 108th through 114th General Assemblies. He is an attorney and co-chairs the Joint Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Stevens was born on October 18, 1973, and holds a J.D. from the University of Memphis and a B.S. in political science from the University of Tennessee at Martin.
He is married and has two children.
In the Senate he is vice-chair of the Finance, Ways, and Means Committee and sits on the Commerce and Labor, Judiciary, and Ethics committees.

His page lists membership in the Tennessee Bar Association and the Carroll County Bar Association, volunteering with the United Way of West Tennessee, and work as an Upward Basketball coach and Sunday school teacher at First Baptist Church in Huntingdon.
